issues.description: play.ts ships debugging scratchpad with deep relative imports and console.log residue
issues.detail: play.ts was rewritten from a clean package import into a scratchpad with console.log calls and a relative path into packages/zod/src. It couples a top-level file to internal source layout and is clearly leftover debugging. Strip before merge.

issues.description: JSON.stringify-based equality for property dedup is the wrong abstraction
issues.detail: Two places in finalize() decide whether to delete a property via JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b). This is order-dependent, fragile on undefined/Date/function values, slow on large schemas, and substitutes a serialization accident for a defined equivalence relation. Extract a named structural-equality helper with a stated contract.

issues.description: flattenRef recursion via seen.parent lacks a stated termination invariant
issues.detail: The ref branch uses seen.ref=null as a sentinel, but the new parent branch calls flattenRef(seen.parent) with no analogous guard. Termination depends on processing order and on the parent's ref already being nulled. State a well-founded order on the Seen graph or enforce it structurally rather than by call sequencing.

issues.description: Seen.ref and Seen.parent overlap without a written contract
issues.detail: Seen now carries two fields with subtle precedence rules (ref===parent, ref!==parent, ref===null sentinel). The invariants live in comments and call sites, not on the type. Document the two-field contract on the Seen interface, or collapse into one field with an explicit kind, so maintainers do not re-conflate the roles.

issues.description: Removing the isParent guard around ctx.override silently doubles user override invocations
issues.detail: Previously override fired only for non-parent nodes; the test's overrideCount jumps from 6 to 12 with no commentary. This is a real contract change for downstream override authors. Either restore the guard or declare the new semantics deliberately in the changelog and test comments rather than accepting a snapshot update.

issues.description: isParentRef check reaches into zodSchema._zod.parent via any cast despite Seen.parent being available
issues.detail: flattenRef has seen.parent in scope but re-derives the relationship through (zodSchema as any)._zod.parent === ref. The local Seen record already carries this information. Compare seen.parent === ref and lift the cast by typing _zod.parent on the schema interface.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the underlying idea — separating clone-chain parent from processor-set ref, plus the fileProcessor anyOf refactor — is sound, but the implementation lands with substantive issues. Three recurring themes: a debugging scratchpad (play.ts) that should not ship, JSON.stringify-as-equality for property dedup that is the wrong data structure, and a flattenRef recursion whose termination over the new parent branch is unspecified. The Seen interface gains two overlapping fields without a written contract, and removing the isParent override guard silently doubles user override invocations. Tighten the Seen contract, replace stringify-equality with a named structural helper, restore or declare the override semantics, and drop play.ts before merge.
